Blender 4.5.1 LTS · Cycles / OptiX · 64 samples for props, 128 for the assembled room. Finished UVs and packed PBR maps; separate metre-scale Y-up GLBs. Fictional photograph generated for the frame; fictional newspaper scans generated for the room clippings. Other maps and paper artwork are original procedural/type work.

These are reusable art assets. The Blender preview uses its own lighting and dust; engine colliders, interactions and equivalent lighting need game scene setup. Keep the repository’s relative folder layout for the linked assembly.
